summary.zh: 只读检查原始 glb：网格、三角面数、UV、材质与贴图是否齐全。结构报告不能代替美术和 Blender 检查。
summary.en: Read-only checks on the raw glb: meshes, triangle count, UVs, materials and textures. A structural report does not replace art or Blender checks.

qa.zh: warning 需逐条阅读，不因报错自动重新生成
qa.en: Read every warning; never auto-regenerate on errors
